title: Demonic Tools And Armour
description: Adds Demonic Tools And Armor and the stuff to make it.
body:
Adds Demonic Tools And Armor and the stuff to make it. Right-click with the sword in your hand to spawn fire on your cursor.

You can repair the sword with a Demonic Block.

You can repair the Tools with a Reinforced Demonic Ingot.

The ore only spawns in the nether.

Crafting recipes are here

It's pretty rare, however, the sword does 152 damage, as stated below.

 

You're welcome to put this in a Modpack, just link this page.

Sword Stats:

Attack Speed = 5

Enchantability = 30

Attack Damage = 152

Number Of Uses = 10000
